name: Penguin-Safe Toxic Link Detection Taxonomy
description: 30 structural, contextual, and architectural patterns for detecting toxic, spammy, or high-risk inbound links.

patterns.name: Excessive Outbound Link Density
patterns.description: Page contains > 1,000 outbound links or > 10,000 links on domain.
patterns.signal: Link farm or public directory spam page

patterns.name: Deindexed or Penalized Domain
patterns.description: Referring domain has zero indexed pages in Google cache/index.
patterns.signal: Domain penalized or deindexed for webmaster guideline violations

patterns.name: Burner Domain Velocity
patterns.description: Domain registered < 30 days ago with > 100 outbound commercial links.
patterns.signal: Disposable burner site built exclusively for manipulative SEO

patterns.name: Coordinated Commercial Exact-Match Anchor Spam
patterns.description: Identical commercial money anchor received from 5+ unrelated low-quality domains within days.
patterns.signal: Negative SEO blast or automated link scheme

patterns.name: Doorway Pages & Parasite Injection
patterns.description: Thin, keyword-stuffed page hosted on compromised or scraped server.
patterns.signal: Automated doorway page redirecting or manipulating anchor weight

patterns.name: Hacked / Malicious Injections
patterns.description: Inbound link from compromised pharma, casino, essay-writing, or adult redirect paths.

patterns.name: Known PBN Footprints
patterns.description: Shared IP blocks, same WHOIS registrant, identical CMS themes, zero brand identity.

patterns.name: Sitewide Footer/Sidebar Link Blasts
patterns.description: Sitewide boiler-plate links appearing across thousands of pages on unrelated niche sites.
patterns.signal: Paid or hacked sitewide link injection

patterns.name: Auto-Spun & Markov AI Scrapes
patterns.description: Unintelligible, machine-scraped gibberish text surrounding target hyperlink.
patterns.signal: Scraper network or spun content syndication

patterns.name: Manual Penalty Association
patterns.description: Domains actively associated with known link sales networks or public link marketplace listings.

categories.action: Flag for human spot-check; disavow if unresolvable

patterns.name: Extreme Outbound to Inbound Link Ratio
patterns.description: Referring domain has > 90% outbound links compared to total inbound authority.

patterns.name: Irrelevant Foreign Language Mismatch
patterns.description: Foreign language domain (e.g., Cyrillic/Chinese) linking to localized English B2B SaaS without context.
patterns.signal: Automated scrapers or syndicated forum spam

patterns.name: Repurposed Expired Domain
patterns.description: Domain history shows complete topical shift (e.g., historic veterinary clinic now linking to crypto).

patterns.name: Excessive Page Link Count
patterns.description: Inbound link originates on a page with > 100 external outbound links.
patterns.signal: Resource listicle farm or unmoderated bookmark directory

patterns.name: Parked / Zero Organic Traffic Domain
patterns.description: Domain generates 0 organic visits and consists solely of parking ads or placeholder links.

patterns.name: Triangular or Reciprocal Link Rings
patterns.description: Reciprocal link pattern (Site A -> Site B -> Site A) across 5+ sites in a network.

patterns.name: Low Quality Web 2.0 Spun Pages
patterns.description: Free subdomain properties (e.g. *.blogspot.com, *.wordpress.com) with < 200 words and 1 link.

patterns.name: Zombie Article Directories
patterns.description: Submissions on legacy syndication sites (EzineArticles, ArticleBiz, GoArticles).

patterns.name: Low Quality Guest Post Marketplaces
patterns.description: Sites featuring 'Write for us' banners with unmoderated commercial links across every topic.

patterns.name: Total Niche Disconnect
patterns.description: Plumbing contractor or gambling casino linking to an AI developer SDK.

categories.action: Monitor; do not disavow unless toxic ratio exceeds 10%

patterns.name: Automated Social Bookmarking Ingestion
patterns.description: Mass automated links from Reddit/Twitter scrapers or social bookmark clones.

patterns.name: Empty Forum User Profiles
patterns.description: Profile pages on vBulletin/Discourse with zero post history and homepage link in bio.

patterns.name: Low-End Press Release Syndication
patterns.description: Identical press release syndicated verbatim across 200 scraper domains without canonical tag.

patterns.name: Coupon and Voucher Scrapers
patterns.description: Scraped 'discount code' or 'coupon' listings with fake tracking redirects.

patterns.name: Generic Uncategorized Directories
patterns.description: Directories with zero editorial oversight that accept all URLs automatically.

patterns.name: Hidden or Offscreen CSS Links
patterns.description: Links rendered with display:none, opacity:0, or positioned -9999px offscreen.

patterns.name: Cloaked Content Discrepancies
patterns.description: HTML served to Googlebot differs from human browser view.

patterns.name: Thin Affiliate Bridge Pages
patterns.description: Pages with 0 original text, purely serving as redirect bridges to affiliate destinations.

patterns.name: Unmoderated Blog Comment Spams
patterns.description: Keyword name spam in WordPress comment sections (e.g. 'Best CRM software' as commenter name).

patterns.name: High Velocity Single-Domain Link Flooding
patterns.description: > 500 links originating from a single internal taxonomy or calendar tag on one external domain.

when_to_disavow: Site has received a Google Manual Action for unnatural inbound links
Clear targeted negative SEO attack with hundreds of spam domains in a short window
Toxic links exceed 10% of total referring domains
Explicitly identified PBNs or link farms linking with commercial exact-match anchors
when_NOT_to_disavow: Naturally occurring low-authority scraper links (Google ignores these automatically)
Links with rel='nofollow', rel='sponsored', or rel='ugc'
Legitimate niche blogs with lower DA/DR
Spam link volume is < 2% of overall backlink profile
